title: 2026 ManpowerGroup Global Workforce Trends: AI, Automation & Human Edge
discussion_signal: The post frames AI and automation as shifting the role of human work toward changing skills, trust, workforce redesign, and adaptation rather than only asking whether jobs disappear.
linked_research_question: How is AI shifting work toward job redesign, rapid relearning, trust, and a weaker traditional employment bargain?
limits: The post announces a workforce trend report and does not provide worker-level outcomes
Employer-facing framing may emphasize adaptation over displacement or bargaining conflict
It does not establish which skills or groups benefit most
